status: supplementary source-domain positive control frozen before inspecting its outcomes; source gate already known
purpose: The source's original planted gate uses constant seed 5, outside the source default search's seed 0 or 1. Construct a plant within the searched seed domain and verify the complete one-tap 28 coefficient by 2 seed by 2 sign grid can rank a compatible decode.
plaintext: THE TOTIENT FUNCTION IS SACRED AND THE PRIMES ARE SACRED KNOW THIS THAT THE INSTAR EMERGENCE IS AT HAND THE PILGRIM SHALL FIND THE SACRED TRUTH
encoder: Use source greedy English-to-GP29 transliteration, then construct ciphertext c_i = p_i - sign*(c0 + 7*c_(i-1)) mod 29 for i>=1; first c_0=p_0-sign*c0 mod29. This is the constant-seed case of source encipher_ctfeedback: skip draws do not change a constant seed value.
search: For each plant, evaluate all 28 nonzero one-tap coefficients, const0/const1, signs -1/+1, offset0 with the source decode_with_coeffs and English score. Record true-rule score, plaintext-index agreement, rank/ties and best score; compare unit coefficient a1=1 under same seed/sign.
criterion: The true rule should recover the planted plaintext indices exactly and score above source -5.2 signal threshold. Rank one or a documented score tie is desirable but not required; report rank honestly.
limits: This is not a blind real-page test, not a control for two- or three-tap coefficients and not a test of key-skip resynchronization because constant seeds make skips observationally irrelevant.
